themes.name: Non-human pickup mishandled (voicemail / IVR / carrier announcement / screening bot)
themes.action: Add an answering-machine/IVR/screener classifier that runs before the conversational flow starts. Branch to a dedicated short flow per pickup type (leave one concise VM message and hang up; answer a screener's questions then stop; disengage immediately from a robocall/hold-queue) instead of running the live-call script. Suppress WPM/latency/WER/greeting/call-flow flags on calls classified this way - those metrics don't mean anything against a machine.

themes.short: Opener doesn't fire when callee speaks first
themes.name: Scripted opener doesn't fire when the callee speaks first
themes.action: Redesign the opening turn so the agent always leads with greeting + self-ID regardless of what the callee says first (e.g. 'Speaking.', 'Hello?', 'Is this X?'). Treat a bare acknowledgment as a cue to proceed into the full greeting, not as a completed exchange.

themes.short: No graceful exit on rejection signals
themes.name: Missing graceful-exit branch on a clear negative/terminal signal
themes.action: Add explicit intent classifiers for rejection / already-purchased / wrong-person / unavailable / off-scope-request that short-circuit straight to a one-line close-out and call termination, instead of falling through to the default script tree or re-asking the same question.

themes.name: Stale or incorrect CRM / dial-list data
themes.action: Feed call verdicts back into the dialer/CRM automatically: when a call resolves as wrong_number, already_addressed, or an explicit do-not-call request, auto-flag that contact/number so it's excluded from future campaigns. Today the agent sometimes promises removal in-call but the list isn't actually updated.

themes.short: Script crams too much into one turn
themes.name: Script crams multiple beats into one breath / one turn runs too long
themes.action: Split compound opener and wrap-up lines (name-confirm + self-ID + dealership + purpose; or decline-ack + courtesy line) into shorter turns with a natural pause between beats.

themes.name: Detector/metric calibration false positive (the measurement is wrong, not the agent's behavior)
themes.action: Patch the scoring pipeline directly: exclude calls below a minimum transcript length from WER scoring, exclude digit-spelled-out utterances from WPM calculation, allowlist the agent's own mandatory disclosure phrase in IVR detection, and replace voicemail keyword-matching with a check for whether a complete message was actually left.

themes.short: No filler phrase during tool latency
themes.name: Tool-call / lookup latency with no filler phrase to mask it
themes.action: Insert a short spoken filler ('Let me check that for you, one moment') immediately before invoking any lookup/tool that can take multiple seconds, so the gap doesn't register as dead air or high latency.

themes.name: Real audio/line quality issues (echo, crosstalk, dropped connection)
themes.action: Not fixable in the agent's script - track separately as a carrier/line-quality metric (echo cancellation, jitter, disconnect rate) rather than folding it into agent-performance issue codes.

themes.short: Customer behavior, not a system defect
themes.name: Genuine customer behavior, not a system defect
themes.action: Auto-classify these as non-actionable at audit time (customer disengaged, declined the recording-consent disclosure, or was never actually engaged) so they stop consuming engineering/product review time as if they were agent failures.
